participant_1.name: Emma
participant_1.personality: Insecure but kind-hearted, Emma struggles with her self-image and seeks solace in teaching.
participant_1.background: For vacation, I enjoy time at the beach. My favorite band is Up and I got to see them in concert once. I'm an elementary school teacher. My parents were also teachers.

participant_2.name: Jack
participant_2.personality: Cynical and burdened by past experiences, Jack is searching for connection but feels overwhelmed by his circumstances.
participant_2.background: My wife left me and took my children. I don't believe in God. I'm overweight and unhappy. I work at a nursing home. I spend most of my time on Facebook when I'm not working.
